english.title: Receiver of scrap metal having made payment by cheque failed to keep copy of it - responsible person
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the person who, under arrangements made by the scrap metal dealer or site manager, had responsibility for doing so, failed to keep a copy of a cheque used to pay for scrap metal
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 13(4) and 15(4) and 15(6) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes:
(i) This offence is not suitable for the scrap metal dealer or site manager themselves. This offence relates to some other person who was given responsibility for carrying out the task in question and failed to do so. See alternative offences:
(a) H10962 (scrap metal dealer)
(b) H11040 (site manager)
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant being the person who, under arrangements made by the scrap metal dealer or site manager, had responsibility for doing so, failed to keep a copy of a cheque used to pay for scrap metal.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
